title: 小三挑衅
slug: 豪门情变前夫过期不候全本免费-豪门情变前夫过期不候最新章节列表
content_zh:
顾少卿挽着心语到慈善舞会的时候，现场等候的记者一下子围拢过来。心语有小小的紧张，不是因为这种场面，而是身边站着顾少卿，这是他第一次带她到公众场合。以前都只能在电视上看到别的女人像这样挽着他，手指不觉用力。
他不停转换着方位配合记者拍照，心语腿上有伤，八寸的高跟鞋很有难度，只能小心翼翼地跟着他。
堂皇富丽的大厅上，吊着蓝色精巧的大宫灯，衣冠楚楚的男士站在落地窗旁交谈甚欢，不时发出酒杯碰撞声。美女如云，香衣靓影，群芳斗艳。
“顾太太的礼服好漂亮！”
“人更漂亮，只有顾太太这样的气质才能穿出这样完美的效果！”
过来寒喧的人或真情或假意的赞美，心语也只微微笑笑，礼貌道谢，大方得体。
“那不是顾氏新签的代言Charlene（莎琳）……”人群中有人低低喊了一句，欲言又止的样子。
众人巡声望过去，皆变了脸色，有蹙眉担心的，有想要看好戏的……
心语抬眼，莎琳穿着和自己一模一样的礼服，这种场合，撞衫有多尴尬，不言而喻，再则她公然这样出现，很明显是挑衅。
心语挽顾少卿的手收紧，看了他一眼，他眼底波澜不惊。
莎琳媚笑嫣然朝心语走过来，故意作出很惊讶的样子，“对不起，顾太太，我不知道这衣服送出去两件……”欲言又止，故意装出说漏嘴的惊慌。
“听莎琳小姐的意思，这礼服是有心人送的，是您的男朋友吗？”现场的记者怎么会错过这一场好戏，纷纷起哄。
莎琳看着顾少卿媚眼横飞，摆好笑容回应记者，“我们今天来都是作善事的，怎么扯到我身上了？”
“顾太太和顾氏的代言人都相中同一款礼服，顾总觉得哪位穿得漂亮些？”好事的记者还在火上浇油。
所有人将目光投向顾少卿，这种时候，关键是看男人的态度，那个女人不管什么身份，只要得到男人的宠爱，就是胜利者。
心语挽紧顾少卿，紧张得整个背都绷得直直的，‘不要，不要在这个时候抛下我！’
顾少卿唇角勾起一丝讥诮，搂着她腰的手松开，莎琳脸上已经露出胜利笑容。
“莎琳代表的是我顾氏的，你们说谁更漂亮呢？”顾少卿略到调侃的开口。
他的意思再明白不过，现场的记者也不敢太过份，只是附合着干笑，“请顾总和莎琳小姐拍个照吧！”
莎琳毫不犹豫站到顾少卿身边，挤开心语，鞋实在太高，心语踉跄着站不稳，强有力的长臂搂住她……

content_en:
When Gu Shaoqing went to the charity ball with Xinyu on her arm, reporters waiting at the scene suddenly gathered around her. Xinyu was a little nervous, not because of this kind of scene, but because Gu Shaoqing was standing next to her. This was the first time he took her to a public place. In the past, I could only see other women holding his arms like this on TV, with their fingers feeling too hard.
He kept changing his position to take pictures with reporters. Xinyu had an injury on his leg and it was difficult to wear eight-inch high heels, so she could only follow him cautiously.
In the majestic and magnificent hall, large blue exquisite palace lanterns were hung. Well-dressed men stood by the floor-to-ceiling windows and chatted happily, making the sound of clinking wine glasses from time to time. Beautiful women are like clouds, with fragrant clothes and beautiful shadows.
"Mrs. Gu's dress is so beautiful!"
"People are more beautiful. Only Mrs. Gu's temperament can produce such a perfect effect!"
People who come over to greet me may express genuine or false compliments, but their inner words are just a smile, a polite thank you, and a generous and appropriate expression.
"That's not Gu's newly signed spokesperson Charlene..." Someone in the crowd shouted in a low voice, hesitating to speak.
As everyone passed by, their expressions changed. Some were frowning and worried, while some wanted to watch a good show...
Xinyu raised her eyes and saw that Shaline was wearing a dress exactly like hers. It was self-evident how embarrassing it was to wear different clothes on such an occasion. Furthermore, her appearance in such a blatant manner was obviously a provocation.
Xinyu tightened Gu Shaoqing's hand and glanced at him, his eyes were calm.
Charlene walked towards Xinyu with a charming smile, deliberately pretending to be surprised, "I'm sorry, Mrs. Gu, I didn't know that two pieces of these clothes were given away..." She hesitated to speak, deliberately pretending to be panicked.
"I heard from Miss Shalin that this dress was given to me by someone who cared about me. Is it your boyfriend?" The reporters at the scene started to boo how could they miss this good show.
Charlene looked at Gu Shaoqing with charming eyes, put on a smile and responded to the reporter, "We are all doing good deeds today, why does it involve me?"
"Mrs. Gu and Mr. Gu's spokesperson both like the same dress. Which one does Mr. Gu think looks better?" The reporter who was busy adding fuel to the fire.
Everyone turned their attention to Gu Shaoqing. At this time, the key is to look at the man's attitude. No matter what the woman's status is, as long as she is favored by the man, she is the winner.
Xinyu held Gu Shaoqing tightly, her whole back stiffened with nervousness, 'No, don't leave me at this time! ’
A trace of ridicule curled up at the corner of Gu Shaoqing's lips, and the hand around her waist loosened, and a victorious smile appeared on Shalin's face.
"Sha Lin represents my Gu family. Who do you think is more beautiful?" Gu Shaoqing said teasingly.
His meaning was very clear, and the reporters at the scene did not dare to go too far. They just laughed and said, "Mr. Gu, please take a photo with Miss Shalin!"
Shalin did not hesitate to stand next to Gu Shaoqing and squeezed Xinyu. The shoes were too high and Xinyu staggered unsteadily. She hugged her with her strong long arms...
PS: Love changes in love for rich families: ex-husband, please don’t wait until the expiration date.
